info.title: TestLens
info.description: Discover, run and track automated tests across C#, Vue and Angular projects. Generates a beautiful self-contained HTML report with full run history, trends and highlights.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: Generate a demo report with sample data

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory (default: <directory>/.testlens)

options.name: --no-run
options.description: Static analysis only - discover tests without executing them

options.name: --npm-install
options.description: Run 'npm install' for JS projects missing node_modules

options.name: --label
options.description: Attach a label to this run (shown in the report timeline)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-project test run timeout (default: 600)

options.name: --fail-on-errors
options.description: Exit code 1 when tests fail or a runner errors (for CI)

options.name: --version
options.description: Print version

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
The report is a single self-contained HTML file: <out>/index.html.
Every scan appends to <out>/history/ so you can travel back and forth
through past runs directly in the report.
Powered by IT Performance ApS
